mapper.select: select u.user_id as teacherId, u.nick_name as teacherName, u.user_name as realName, (select p.teacher_subject from edu_teacher_profile p where p.user_id = u.user_id) as teacherSubject from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.role_key = 'teacher' and r.status = '0' where u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' order by u.user_id

select s.teacher_id as teacherId, r.schedule_id as scheduleId, r.class_date as classDate, s.class_mode as classMode, case when s.grade_name in ('初一','初二','初三') then 'junior' when s.grade_name in ('高一','高二','高三') then 'senior' else 'primary' end as stage, s.start_time as startTime, s.end_time as endTime, count(*) as totalRows, sum(case when r.sign_status in ('1','4','5') then 1 else 0 end) as attendedRows from edu_class_sign_in r inner join edu_course_schedule s on s.schedule_id = r.schedule_id and s.del_flag = '0' where r.del_flag = '0' and r.review_status = '1' and s.teacher_id is not null and date_format(r.class_date, '%Y-%m') = #{salaryMonth} group by s.teacher_id, r.schedule_id, r.class_date, s.class_mode, stage, s.start_time, s.end_time

select s.schedule_id as scheduleId, s.teacher_id as teacherId, s.course_class_name as courseClassName, s.grade_name as gradeName, s.class_pattern as classPattern, s.period_name as periodName, s.class_mode as classMode, s.start_time as startTime, s.end_time as endTime, s.start_date as startDate, s.end_date as endDate from edu_course_schedule s where s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0' and s.teacher_id is not null and s.term_name in ('寒假', '春季') and s.start_date is not null and s.end_date is not null order by s.teacher_id, s.schedule_id
